speaker: A
text: Hey, did you get a chance to look at the little cafe near the station? I was thinking we could go there on Saturday.

speaker: B
text: I walked past it yesterday. It looks nice, but Saturday morning is a bit difficult. I promised to help my sister move.

speaker: A
text: Oh, right. How about Sunday instead? We could have lunch first, then take a walk by the river if the weather is good.

speaker: B
text: Sunday works for me. Actually, I would rather meet a little later. Is one thirty okay? I don't want to rush in the morning.

speaker: A
text: Sure. Let's meet outside the station at one thirty. Do you know if the cafe has vegetarian food?

speaker: B
text: Their menu had a mushroom sandwich and a tomato soup. I'll check whether we need a reservation, and send you the address tonight.

speaker: A
text: Perfect, thanks. And if it rains, we can skip the walk and visit that bookstore next door. I've been meaning to go there for ages.

speaker: B
text: That sounds like a good backup plan. I'll bring the book I borrowed from you, too. See you on Sunday!
